review_response_tasks.stem: The witness could not ____ the driver because it was dark and she had not seen his face.
review_response_tasks.rationale: identify：identify辨认人对应未见face；appoint任命/consume消耗/borrow借不表辨身份。

review_response_tasks.stem: The concert was cancelled ____ because the roof was unsafe, not because ticket sales were low.
review_response_tasks.rationale: for safety reasons：明确unsafe roof原因for safetyreasons；coincidence巧合与原因不合，onsale出售，insilence方式不解取消缘由。

review_response_tasks.stem: After waiting all morning, she finally ____ when her name was called. She had to stand to receive the award.
review_response_tasks.rationale: rose to her feet：stand领奖对应rosefeet；发脾气/保持距离/视而不见无该起立动作。

review_response_tasks.stem: The shop agreed to ____ the damaged item with a new one at no extra cost.
review_response_tasks.rationale: replace：replaceAwithB以新换坏；predict预测/resist抵抗/deserve应得不构成该替换。

review_response_tasks.stem: The curtains are ____, so people outside cannot see through them.
review_response_tasks.rationale: opaque：opaque不透；transparent透明相反，portable可携/edible可食不解释看不穿。

review_response_tasks.stem: A gentle ____ moved the leaves, but the air was not strong enough to disturb the papers.
review_response_tasks.rationale: breeze：gentle轻风breeze；hurricane强风与gentle反，earthquake/flood不是此温和气流。

review_response_tasks.stem: The group hopes to ____ awareness of the local collection by holding an open evening.
review_response_tasks.rationale: raise：raiseawareness提升认知固定搭配；owe欠/hide隐蔽/spend花费不能表达该宣传意图。

review_response_tasks.stem: The note says the delay is “brief”. Here “brief” means ____.
review_response_tasks.rationale: short：brief短暂short；permanent永久相反，frequent频次，dangerous危险非时长。

review_response_tasks.stem: The cover is designed to ____ the screen from scratches during transport.
review_response_tasks.rationale: protect：protectfrom保护免刮；accuse控告/threaten威胁/imitate模仿不表保护。

review_response_tasks.stem: To ____ unnecessary packaging, customers can bring their own containers.
review_response_tasks.rationale: reduce：自带容器减少包装reduce；generate生成/expand扩大反，overlook忽略不等减少量。

review_response_tasks.stem: In the 1990 story, Jo left home not knowing that she ____ return for ten years.
review_response_tasks.rationale: would not：过去视角未发生未来10年，wouldnotreturn；hasnot/hadnot需returned非return，isnot接return不合。

review_response_tasks.stem: The club provides a setting ____ newcomers can ask basic questions without feeling foolish.
review_response_tasks.rationale: where：setting作场景从句不缺主宾需where；which缺介词不充场所，whose需名词，when时间非setting地点。

review_response_tasks.stem: The lamp ____ above the door ____ the entrance at night.
review_response_tasks.rationale: hanging; lights：hanging修饰lamp+lights限定谓语；hung;lighting缺限定，hangs;lights两个无连接谓语，hanging;lighting也无限定。

review_response_tasks.stem: The number of members ____ steadily since January.
review_response_tasks.rationale: has grown：since至今、number单数hasgrown；grow数错，isgrow/willgrew结构错。

review_response_tasks.stem: The forms ____ by the office last Friday contain the revised address.
review_response_tasks.rationale: issued：forms被office发出过去分词issued作定语；issuing主动错，toissuing结构错，issues限定不作该定语。

review_response_tasks.stem: The recording shows him at the meeting, so he ____ there when the decision was made.
review_response_tasks.rationale: must have been：已发生会议录像回推过去musthavebeen；其余现在/未来/一般可能不表过去必然推断。

review_response_tasks.stem: Unless ____ in time, the invitation will arrive too late, ____ the visit impossible.
review_response_tasks.rationale: sent; making：invitation被寄省略ifsent，结果making；sending主动错，send原形不作省略被动，tosend缺合理主语；后made/makes/make均不合结果分词。

review_response_tasks.stem: Several of the paintings ____ already been returned to their owners.
review_response_tasks.rationale: have：severalpaintings复数havebeen；has数错，is/was不能接alreadybeen组成此完成被动。

review_response_tasks.stem: The team added a contents page ____ readers find the right section.
review_response_tasks.rationale: to help：目的tohelp接readersfind；helped/helps不作该目的，helpingto后接readersfind无此结构。

review_response_tasks.stem: ____ the trial carefully, the researcher thanked the volunteers, ____ had given their time freely.
review_response_tasks.rationale: Having observed; who：先观察完用Havingobserved，volunteers在非限从句作主语who；Observed被动不合研究者，which指物，whom宾格、whose后需名词。

student_passage: 各题语境独立。同一选项中有分号时，依次回填该题两个空，但只作答一次。
